data.title: 雪之下阳乃 · 露天咖啡馆的墨镜戏谑注视·「比企谷君，又在用那种腐烂的眼神看世界了呢」
data.description: 【千叶繁华街露天咖啡馆·午后】成熟魔性大姐姐的登场高光。阳乃翘着二郎腿坐在遮阳伞下的藤椅上，米色长风衣敞开露出高领毛衣勾勒出的惊人上围与黑色丝袜长腿。她单手将墨镜稍稍拉低至鼻梁，深邃锐利的凤眸直勾勾盯着你，嘴角扬起让人捉摸不透却心跳加速的妖艳戏谑。
data.location: 千叶商业街露天咖啡座
data.action: 翘腿二郎腿拉低墨镜，风衣敞开黑丝长腿交叠，凤眸戏谑妖艳
data.lighting: 遮阳伞边缘切下的高对比金色阳光与藤椅阴影
data.camera: medium shot, outdoor cafe, sunglasses pulled down, crossed legs, smirk
data.promptProse: Haruno Yukinoshita rests in the terrace's wicker chair with legs crossed, lowering her sunglasses with one finger to give a knowing amused glance. Her open beige trench coat, black turtleneck and pencil skirt retain the elegant winter outfit. The medium view includes the cafe tables and street beyond the parasol. Afternoon sun along its edge brightens the coat and glasses, while woven-chair shadows pattern the shaded seating area.
